exposure: Age of mothers at baby birth
cohort: Infants in Basra (Southern of Iraq) during the study period.
finding: Exclusive breastfeeding in the first six months of life was significantly associated with a reduced risk of diarrhea, respiratory tract infection, and gastroenteritis, and was also associated with mother's age at baby birth, education level, occupation, mode of delivery, gestational age, and parity.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was associated with exclusive breastfeeding.
